verdict.rationale: Docs show a broad API/SDK/CLI surface (provisioning, keys, webhooks, triggers, computers, templates, builds) and CLI --json mode implying the CLI itself is just an API wrapper, suggesting an API-first architecture. However there's no explicit statement of full UI/API parity and no discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes return 404s for all schema locations), so completeness of API coverage relative to every UI feature can't be confirmed. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, published OpenAPI/API reference, independent confirmation that every UI action has an API equivalent.
